name: Mưa tạnh
notes: chapters = seconds in film.mp4 where the film waits for a tap, taken from scene.html by stops.py: the title frame, one stop in each of the five hourly captions (PAUSE.inBeat into its beat), the climax (PAUSE.climax: the words on the glass and the fingertip), and the last frame (morning). Each sits a quarter of a frame into its frame, so a seek shows that frame and round(t * fps) finds its boxes. hints = the scene's own words at those stops (WORDS.cue, ui.next, WORDS.hint, ui.skip); a card can override them with "chapters". reveal = null: no 3D envelope; after the last stop a tap opens the letter. slots.json: cap0-k ... cap4-k are the hours (label), cap0-l ... cap4-l the lines (caption), both fading with the scene (alpha is the 5th number of each box); mist is the words left on the glass (text). The mist is a compromise: in the scene the last of the fog stands on the glass in the shape of the words, which a film shared by every card cannot do. Here the fog leaves a thin uneven cloud round the words' box, clears a soft patch in it as the words come, and the player paints the card's mist words into the patch in the handwriting (Oooh Baby, outlined) in a pale mist colour; the hand wipes the cloud away left to right while the words fade out. fonts = the faces the player paints these slots in (latin, latin-ext and vietnamese).
